authoritative_hierarchy: PRIMARY (when licensed/present): MLB StatsAPI game feed (gamePk + liveData.plays)
SECONDARY (pitch enrichment, not a substitute for missing official plays): Baseball Savant / Statcast
FALLBACK: none. Retrosheet/other feeds require a new parser version and explicit authorization.
authoritative_event_definition: An authoritative event is a discrete official PBP record from the primary source that identifies a game, a source event id, and a sequence position. Pitches, plays, substitutions, reviews, and inning/game boundary records qualify. Kalshi trades are NOT MLB events. Market existence never creates a baseball event.
missing_data: Missing fields are DataField::Unavailable { reason }. Missing games/seasons are MISSING_HISTORICAL_SOURCE. Never synthesize state because a Kalshi market exists.
duplicate_events: Same (source, source_game_id, source_event_id): identical payload is idempotent; divergent payload is a conflict (fail closed). Sequence collisions fail closed.
corrected_pbp: Amendments (review overturn, official correction) are explicit events citing amends_event_id. Raw source bytes are never overwritten. Canonical sequence applies amendments in order.
source_conflict: Disagreement between primary and secondary is recorded as SOURCE_CONFLICT. W2 does not auto-pick a winner.
timestamp_domains: canonical_order — sequence number; optional source time for ties
